title: Object Storage: outage claim — concession proportion and monetary maximum
content:
For Object Storage outage claim, when the availability band is positive, add the support portfolio discount proportion to that band and cap the combined proportion at storage cumulative outage credit cap proportion; when the band is zero the combined proportion is zero. Multiply the original source net amount once by that combined proportion and round the total service-credit maximum half-up to the tier monetary precision decimal places.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage claim in this situation? When the availability band is positive, add the support portfolio discount proportion to that band and cap the combined proportion at storage cumulative outage credit cap proportion; when the band is zero the combined proportion is zero. Multiply the original source net amount once by that combined proportion and round the total service-credit maximum half-up to the tier monetary precision decimal places.

## Hypothetical outage claim — concession proportion and monetary maximum case

For this outage claim — concession proportion and monetary maximum example, assume hypothetical inputs of a positive availability proportion of 0.12, a support proportion of 0.07, a storage cap of 0.25 and original invoice net of USD 700. The combined proportion is 0.19 and the maximum is USD 133. Applying separate successive rates would not reproduce this maximum. If the hypothetical availability proportion is zero, the combined proportion and maximum are zero even with the support entitlement.
